- Changed how the media viewer opens; photos and videos now open inside the app window over a blurred and dimmed view of it, with space around the media, a top bar showing the sender, date and actions, round previous and next buttons on the sides, video controls attached to the bottom edge of the video that hide with the other controls when the pointer rests, and a strip of rounded thumbnails for all media in the chat with a position counter at the bottom, instead of covering the whole screen; full screen is available from the top bar button, a double-click on the top edge or video full screen, expands smoothly from the window and shrinks back to it, and Esc returns to the window first
- Changed the more menu and the video settings menu in the media viewer to open on click, so they no longer pop up when the pointer passes over their buttons
- Improved the in-window media viewer in small windows; the margins around the media narrow with the window, the video controls move below the previous and next buttons instead of covering them, and forward and save move into the more menu when the top bar runs out of space
- Added a light look for the video controls in the in-window media viewer; their background, icons, progress bar, time and settings menu now follow the app theme, while the classic viewer keeps its dark controls
- Added tooltips to the media viewer buttons, including the top bar actions, the previous and next buttons and the video controls; the controls stay visible while the pointer rests on a button
- Added a custom logo for the folder sidebar and the top of the chat list, scaled to the original logo size, with an option to follow the theme color
- Added viewing video covers from the context menu, which opens the uploader's cover, or the thumbnail generated by Telegram, full size in the media viewer
- Improved switching chats, which now fades the chat area and the selected chat row in place, and messages that finish loading after the switch fade in instead of popping up
- Improved opening the archive, forums and folder tabs, which now blends the chat list in place instead of sliding the whole column
- Improved settings navigation, which now covers the window from the right when settings open and blends between settings pages in place instead of sliding them sideways
- Changed how settings search works; it now opens from a search button as a floating panel over the dimmed window instead of a field in the title bar
- Changed how the folder sidebar looks; it no longer shows a scrollbar, and scrolling works as before
- Fixed an issue with emoji picked right after sending a message that previously caused them to sit slightly above the text line in the input field

---

- 新增了视频预览，现在可以在支持的频道视频右键菜单中打开媒体查看器逐帧大图浏览，并从任意一帧开始播放
- 对切换对话进行了改善，这使得对话区和选中的对话行原地淡入淡出，切换后才加载出来的消息也会淡入，不再突然出现
- 对进入归档、论坛和切换文件夹标签进行了改善，这使得对话列表原地过渡，不再整列左右滑动
- 对设置页的切换进行了改善，这使得设置页打开时从右侧覆盖窗口，各设置页之间原地淡入淡出，不再左右滑动
- 调整了设置搜索的方式，现在通过搜索按钮打开悬浮在变暗窗口上的搜索面板，不再显示在标题栏里
- 调整了左侧文件夹栏的样式，现在不再显示滚动条，滚动照常可用
- 修复了关于发送消息后立刻插入表情的错误，该问题曾导致表情在输入框中比文字略高
